summary: Till mode (scan-to-sell at the till) and the Finds condition filter: 7 of 8 acceptance criteria verified clean; 1 real frontend display bug found (condition-filter trigger shows the raw value 'all' instead of the 'Any condition' label — functional filtering itself works correctly). Backend: new pytest file covers PATCH /inventory/{id}/sell at recommended_price and the reversible un-sell. Browser: updated the two now-stale QuickFind scan checks (they asserted the old 'scan navigates to /tag' behavior, which the new spec deliberately replaced with the till dialog) plus 6 new named checks for sell-at-tag-price, already-sold handling, the Open-item escape hatch, condition-filter narrowing, condition+status composition, and clear-filters reset. One check re-ran against the public preview URL. Full backend suite re-run: 75/80 passing — the 5 failures are the same pre-existing, out-of-scope issues already flagged in iterations 19/20 (shops-count==14 residue from an earlier session's test data, and a missing /tmp/item.jpg live-model fixture for 2 real-appraise tests); none touch till mode or the condition filter.

checks.criterion: Finds condition filter narrows the grid
checks.name: finds-condition-filter-narrows-grid
checks.evidence: BUG: finds-condition-filter trigger renders the literal selected value instead of its label. Default/reset state shows text 'all' (expected 'Any condition'). Functional behavior is otherwise correct: selecting finds-condition-option-Good narrowed finds-count from the full total to exactly the API's count of condition==='Good' items, and the visible finds-card-<id> set equalled that exact id set (cross-checked via GET /api/inventory); reselecting 'Any condition' restored the full count. Screenshot: finds-condition-filter-narrows-grid-failure.png shows the trigger reading 'all▼'. Backend cross-check: GET /api/inventory -> 401 without auth / 200 with auth, confirming the API is healthy and this is a frontend render-only defect (Finds.tsx's <SelectValue placeholder="Any condition" /> has no render-function children, unlike every other Select in this codebase e.g. Inventory.tsx's <SelectValue>{(v) => v === 'all' ? 'All categories' : v}</SelectValue>, so base-ui's Select.Value prints the raw value once one is selected instead of the placeholder).

checks.criterion: Condition filter composes with the status and PAT filters
checks.name: finds-condition-filter-composes-with-status-filter
checks.evidence: Good + Available: finds-count and the visible finds-card-<id> set both matched the API intersection of condition==='Good' && status==='available' exactly (not the condition-only or status-only counts). Good + PAT pending: matched the condition==='Good' && is_electrical && !pat_passed intersection (empty in this dataset, correctly rendered finds-empty rather than falling back to either single filter).

checks.name: finds-clear-filters-resets-search-status-condition

Tapping it: finds-search value cleared to '', finds-filter-all aria-selected='true', condition trigger back to its default value state ('all' - see the separate label-text bug above), finds-count restored to the original full total.

bugs.criterion: Finds condition filter narrows the grid
bugs.description: The Finds condition-filter trigger (data-testid finds-condition-filter) displays the raw selected value ('all') instead of its label ('Any condition') because frontend/src/pages/Finds.tsx passes `<SelectValue placeholder="Any condition" />` with no render-function children. Every other Select in the codebase (Inventory.tsx category/location/size/sort filters, Activity.tsx, Appraise.tsx) passes `<SelectValue>{(v) => ...label...}</SelectValue>` to map the stored value to display text; Finds.tsx's condition filter is missing that mapping, so base-ui's Select.Value falls through to printing the raw value once a value is set (the placeholder only renders when the value is empty/undefined, and the default value here is the non-empty string 'all'). Filtering logic itself is unaffected — only the label text is wrong, both on initial load and after 'Clear filters'.
bugs.evidence: Screenshot finds-condition-filter-narrows-grid-failure.png: trigger reads 'all▼'. Fix suggestion: `<SelectValue placeholder="Any condition">{(v) => (v === 'all' ? 'Any condition' : (v as string))}</SelectValue>`.

action_items: Fix Finds.tsx condition-filter SelectValue to render the 'Any condition' label for value==='all' (see bugs[0]).
